reconciled.line: skill1 'while not in Missile Guide' re-trigger gate
reconciled.driver: originally documented as 'no damage impact' (shotFired refresh)
reconciled.reviewer: nearest-wrong = ungated permanent uptime erases the periodic full-120f charge and inflates shot count
reconciled.resolution: REVIEWER ADOPTED. Driver's 'no damage impact' caveat was WRONG and is corrected: shotFired refreshes the durationShots:3 window every full charge → near-permanent Missile Guide uptime, whereas the true kit lapses MG after 3 rounds and re-grants only on the next un-buffed (120f) charge — a duty cycle the encoding over-credits. The engine has no 'not-currently-buffed' self-gate primitive, so the gate is unexpressible; the durationShots:3 + removeOnReload STRUCTURE is faithful, only the uptime is inflated. Elevated to ⚑5 with estimate (~1-in-4 charges slow) + recipe (focus-video the slow-charge recurrence). NOT fudged to an averaged chargeSpeed (measured>fudge).
